prompt: IMPORTANT: the white cat MUST REMAIN A REAL PHOTOGRAPHED CAT in every frame - individual hairs, natural fur, real whiskers, normal cat eyes. Never smooth, never glossy, never cartoonish, never a plush toy. It never turns into a person and stays the size of a grown adult human. Plain live television look: no sparks, no fire, no glowing effects, no cartoon effects. Nobody wears boxing gloves or MMA gloves - bare knuckles with thin hand wraps only, the cat's paws are bare fur. Anatomy stays correct: no twisted or inverted joints, no rubbery limbs, no extra limbs. Continuous single shot, no cuts, camera completely LOCKED on a tripod with only a tiny tremble; it does NOT zoom, push in, orbit or travel. Bare-knuckle boxing ring. Timing, follow it exactly: SECONDS 0-1: the fighter in blue shorts rushes forward at the giant white cat, both fully visible. SECONDS 1-2: the cat calmly extends ONE front paw and places it flat on the man's forehead, holding him at arm's length. Its arm stays straight and completely still. SECONDS 2-6: THIS IS THE JOKE, hold it and keep everything else still. The man swings both arms wildly again and again, throwing punch after punch into empty air - every punch falls short and NEVER touches the cat. He leans in, pushes with his legs, grabs at the paw - and cannot move a centimetre closer. The cat does not move at all: its arm stays locked straight, its body does not shift, its face stays completely bored. It slowly blinks once and glances away as if uninterested. SECONDS 6-7: the cat gives one short push with that same paw and the man is knocked backwards and falls COMPLETELY OUT OF THE FRAME - after that he is not visible at all. SECONDS 7-8: the cat is alone in frame, standing upright on its hind legs. It looks at its paw and licks it once. Shot on a long telephoto lens with shallow depth of field: the fighters and the ropes sharp, the crowd and the banners out of focus, no letters or logos legible behind the ring. The ring stays exactly as in the first frame. Do not invent or re-spell any text, no gibberish, no logos of any other fight promotion. Real speed, natural motion blur. Photorealistic. No blood, no injury, comedic tone. Audio: arena crowd, the swish of punches hitting nothing, the crowd starting to laugh louder and louder, then one thud as he goes down and the crowd erupts. No music, no commentary, no speech.
